newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 14.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY AND OTHER MAJOR NEWSPAPERS

Full text of resolutions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on certain important questions on promoting socialist ethical and cultural progress -- a blueprint for Chinese society and China's advancement along economic reform into the 21st century.
State Councillor Chen Junsheng urges government officials at all levels to take a personal interest in promoting the employment of rural labourers while developing the rural economy.
Liu Hongru, former chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, urges development of China's capital markets.
China's central bank calls for tighter supervision of overseas branches of Chinese financial institutions.
China hails development of domestic stock market.
